tasks.label: f1: Update f1db submodule
tasks.command: git -C f1db fetch upstream && git -C f1db checkout add-docker && git -C f1db rebase upstream/main && git -C f1db push origin add-docker -f

tasks.label: f1: Predict EV
tasks.command: YEAR='${input:targetYear}'; ROUND='${input:targetRound}'; ARGS=''; [ -n "$YEAR" ] && ARGS="--year $YEAR"; [ -n "$ROUND" ] && ARGS="$ARGS --round $ROUND"; conda run --no-capture-output -n f1_fantasy python -m src.predict_ev $ARGS

tasks.label: f1: Optimize Team
tasks.command: EV=$(ls -t '${workspaceFolder}/data/ev_reports/ev_report_'*.csv 2>/dev/null | head -1) && [ -n "$EV" ] && conda run --no-capture-output -n f1_fantasy python src/optimize_lp.py "$EV" 100.0 --top-n 5 || echo 'No EV report found — run f1: Predict EV first.'

tasks.label: f1: Predict EV + Optimize
tasks.command: YEAR='${input:targetYear}'; ROUND='${input:targetRound}'; ARGS=''; [ -n "$YEAR" ] && ARGS="--year $YEAR"; [ -n "$ROUND" ] && ARGS="$ARGS --round $ROUND"; conda run --no-capture-output -n f1_fantasy python -m src.predict_ev $ARGS && EV=$(ls -t '${workspaceFolder}/data/ev_reports/ev_report_'*.csv 2>/dev/null | head -1) && conda run --no-capture-output -n f1_fantasy python src/optimize_lp.py "$EV" 100.0 --top-n 5

inputs.description: Season year — leave blank to auto-detect
Round number — leave blank to auto-detect
